title: Oro Deum
byline: From the Confession of St. Patrick

english: Wherefore then, I shall render unto him
for all his benefits towards me.

latin: Sed quid dicam uel quid promittam
english: But what shall I say, or what shall I promise to my Lord?
For I am only worth what he himself has given to me.

latin: Oro Deum ut det mihi perseuerantiam,
english: I pray God to give me perseverance,
and to vouchsafe that I bear to him faithful witness,
until my passing hence, for the sake of my God.
